yes → especially in the evening → be in a bad mood → eat something delicious → comfort myself → not a healthy habit → my stomach and my health don't always agree

yourself

text:
Q1: Do you often feel hungry?
你经常觉得饿吗？
答题思路：
yes → especially in the evening → be in a bad mood → eat something delicious → comfort myself → not a healthy habit → my stomach and my health don't always agree
是的一尤其是晚上 一心情不好一吃点好吃的一安慰自己一不太健康的习惯 >胃和健康有时意见不一
Q2: Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
你更喜欢在家吃饭还是出去吃？
答题思路：
prefer eating out when busy → save time → enjoy eating at home on weekends → take my time → more than filling your stomach - relax and enjoy
